title: Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24214v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling laws are widely used to predict foundation model performance and guide compute allocation. However, tabular foundation models (TFMs) differ from conventional foundation models in that they are pretrained on virtually unlimited synthetic data from configurable distributions, while ultimately being evaluated on real-world datasets. We investigate whether scaling laws for TabPFNv2-style models reliably extrapolate to larger compute budgets and generalize across evaluation settings. Our analysis reveals differences between synthetic and real-world scaling behavior and shows that accurately fitting a scaling law does not necessarily yield reliable prescriptions on unseen datasets. In particular, selecting configurations using too few evaluation datasets leads to systematically over-optimistic performance estimates. We further demonstrate that compute-optimal scaling requires expanding the range of synthetic pretraining dataset sizes

translated_title: 迈向可靠的表格基础模型缩放定律
translated_abstract: 缩放定律被广泛用于预测基础模型的性能并指导计算资源分配。然而，表格基础模型与传统基础模型的不同之处在于，它们是在来自可配置分布的几乎无限的合成数据上进行预训练的，而最终却在真实世界数据集上进行评估。我们研究了TabPFNv2风格模型的缩放定律能否可靠地外推到更大的计算预算，并在不同的评估设置之间泛化。我们的分析揭示了合成数据与真实世界数据之间缩放行为的差异，并表明准确拟合缩放定律并不一定能在未见过的数据集上给出可靠的指导建议。特别是，使用过少的评估数据集来选择配置会导致系统性地过度乐观的性能估计。我们进一步证明，实现计算最优的缩放需要扩大合成预训练数据集大小的范围。
tldr: 该研究揭示了表格基础模型在合成数据与真实数据上缩放行为的差异，指出准确拟合缩放定律并不能保证在未见数据集上的可靠预测，且使用过少的评估数据集选择配置会导致系统性过度乐观，而计算最优缩放需要扩大合成预训练数据集规模的搜索范围。
en_tdlr: This study reveals discrepancies between synthetic and real-world scaling behavior of tabular foundation models, showing that accurately fitting scaling laws does not guarantee reliable predictions on unseen datasets and that compute-optimal scaling requires expanding the range of synthetic pretraining dataset sizes.
